career.plan_step.intro: Optional, but helpful: in the career plan the career coach records your target roles, target industries and the timeline for your move with you. Its tips and job suggestions follow it. You can also start any time later.
career.plan_step.not_ready: For a meaningful career plan, this is still missing: {items}. Record it first – then the career coach can get started.
career.package.summary: Job-change advice with a CV profile, a career plan and a job scan every working day
career.help.job_search.title: Job search & matching
career.help.job_search.description: Find and rate suitable jobs, bookmark interesting matches.
career.help.job_search.ex1: Please bookmark this job: Scrum Master at Beispiel GmbH in Hamburg.
career.help.advice.title: Career advice & planning
career.help.advice.body: The career coach advises on changing jobs, maintains your career profile (current role, skills, experience) and your career plan (target roles, target industries, timeline for the change) and researches with dated sources on the web.
career.cron.score_jobs.on_message: All right — from now on I will look for suitable jobs on several job boards every working-day morning (Bundesagentur, Adzuna and JSearch — which also brings in StepStone and LinkedIn jobs) and only report good matches (you rate them with 👍/👎 and I learn your preferences). You can switch it off any time with the button.
career.cron.score_jobs.off_message: The working-day job scan is off. I no longer search for jobs automatically.
career.jobcard.feedback_hint: Tap 👍/👎. Afterwards you can optionally tell me why in ONE sentence – I'll remember it for future suggestions.
career.offer.scan: Noted. Would you like me to search for matching jobs for you every weekday from now on and send them with a short rating? You rate each one with 👍/👎 and I learn your preferences. You can turn it off with a button at any time.
career.advisor.plan_stale: Your career plan has not been confirmed for {days} days (threshold {threshold} days). Shall we take a quick look whether the target role and timeline still fit?
career.advisor.skill_gaps: You have {count} skill gap(s) for your target role(s).
career.advisor.skill_gaps_blockers: You have {count} skill gap(s) for your target role(s) ({blockers} of them required/show-stoppers).
career.advisor.skill_gaps_cta: Shall we work on the most important gaps?
career.advisor.digest_no_plan: Career advice: no career plan published yet. Tell me your target role and we'll create a plan.
career.cron.score_jobs.label: Job suggestions
